# Re-rank proposal 3 (after card 205, loop boundary)

- Led by: product manager seat, fresh context. Claude seat because probes at 07:24 UTC show Codex, Copilot, Grok and agy without usable quota (.mob/records/probes/2026-10-30.jsonl).
- Before list (Ready): 213, 209, 210, 208, 211, 212, 206, 207.
- Proposed after list:
  1. 213 (checker rejects an incomplete objection window; D153 L3b, no window counts until it is on main)
  2. 209 (MD-001)
  3. 210 (MD-003)
  4. 208 (MD-002, F-008)
  5. 211 (MD-010, records only, may run in parallel)
  6. 212 (re-rank for every mob; depends on 208)
  7. 206 (F-008, findings mirror; 205 is Done)
  8. 207 (F-008 history rules; depends on 206)
- Rationale (one line): no new evidence moves anything, so the gate for the D153 experiment goes first, then the MD corrective cards in the product owner order of D147, D148 and D149, then the F-008 cards that resume once MD-001, MD-003 and MD-010 are closed.

## What changed and why
Nothing changed in the order. Only 206 and 207 are named in the list because 205 is Done and no longer blocks them; they stay last behind their own dependency chain and the open FAILs.

## Evidence considered
- Findings: MD-001, MD-002, MD-003, MD-010 still open FAIL; F-043 to F-050 are FLAGs and add no card.
- Retro 205: keep 213 for the same six roles; two process picks (A claim-equals-commit gate, B overlap check at slice) go to their own Decider, not into this rank.
- Metrics: 24 minutes from issue to first red on 205 (D153 baseline).
- Model availability: only Claude usable. Overdue-audit blocker still stops card starts until the auditor logs a tick.
- New cards: none since 213.

## Neither a one-way door nor a standing-rule change
The Rank field is edited in git and can be reversed by the next re-rank. It changes no agreement, D-record, checker or published claim, and no data. It applies D148 as amended by D153 L1 (loop-boundary re-rank is a listed routine decision).

## Window rule
Each declared role seat answers in its own fresh context with either "no objection" or ONE fixed condition. A condition that is simply adopted and re-polled stays in the window; an unsettled objection goes to a full Decider.
